research_metadata.task_context: Workspace isolation for Tauri ASCII-art app + Hardware acceleration tiering + Zen mode UI

recommended_color_system.rationale: Monochrome terminal-style aesthetic matching the 'real not gimmick' hardware-first requirement.

recommended_typography.rationale: Monospaced fonts for a technical, hardware-detection-focused UI.

design_signals.recommended_animation_approach: Framer Motion for the Zen mode sidebar transitions; Hardware-accelerated CSS transforms for workspace switching.

lockscreen_specs.interaction: Toggles 'is-zen' class on <body> or root container
lockscreen_specs.side_effects: Sidebars, status bars, and status graphs get 'opacity: 0' and 'pointer-events: none' in Zen mode.
